Chocolate crafters Experience.
Chocolate.

At DeCOCOA, every chocolate is handcrafted with care using the world’s finest sustainably sourced cocoa.

Let’s Craft Something Together

Our Chocolate Chocolate possibilities. Crafted with curiosity.

Explore chocolate products and the craft behind them. From filled chocolate and hollow figures to ingredient mixing and dry filling, discover a starting point for your next confection, gift or business idea.

Explore Our Products

Wellness

Bring your wellness chocolate idea into focus. Explore flavor, texture and ingredient preferences, then talk with us about the confection you want to create.

Explore Wellness

One Shot Depositing

One shot depositing brings chocolate and filling together in a single moulding step. Explore filled chocolate with a contrasting center and a shell shaped around it.

Explore One Shot Depositing

Hollow Moulding

Hollow moulding creates chocolate figures with an open center. Discover how a chocolate shell takes shape, from familiar seasonal figures to playful forms.

Explore Hollow Moulding

Mixing

Mixing brings chocolate and other ingredients together to create different flavors and textures. Explore how the blend can shape the character of a chocolate confection.

Explore Mixing

Dry Filling

Explore dry filling for cocoa powders and chocolate drink mixes. Start a conversation about your product, pack format and filling requirements.

Explore Dry Filling

Our People The heart behind the chocolate.

Our story begins with the Vigneri family and a Sicilian patisserie. That love of confection is part of the DeCocoa story.

Meet Our People

Connections & collaboration Our Partners

Good chocolate brings people together. Discover the ingredient specialists and food brands connected to DeCOCOA’s chocolate craft.

Our Craft Chocolate craftsmanship, with purpose.

At DeCOCOA Chocolate Crafters in Rochester, New York, we blend tradition and technology to make chocolate with precision and care. Quality, food safety and continuous improvement guide our work from sourcing to production.

Explore Our Craft

Care, creativity and integrity

Our promise brings together passionate people and innovative craft, with quality and food safety at every step.

Explore Our Promise

A lighter footprint

Responsible sourcing, eco-friendly packaging and power from Niagara Falls shape our approach to more sustainable chocolate making.

Explore Our Sustainability

Craft for professionals

From chocolate production and customizable DeCOCOA DeCOR to food and gourmet fulfillment, our capabilities bring care and precision to every project.
